item.title: Multi Agent Collaboration Gets Persistent Compute in Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Amazon Web Services has extended Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with runtime instances, a new compute option that gives AI agents persistent infrastructure purpose-built for complex long-running workflows and multi-agent coordination. (1 source: infoq)
